entries.dialogueText: “However, our revolution here in Valgsland owes a great deal to Malenyev. He is the father of Malenyevism and a symbol of global revolution. Not only is he the first-ever communist revolutionary leader, he managed to unite a whole continent, forming the greatest country in the world.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“We believe that the revolution in..."
entries.dialogueText: “We believe that the revolution in Valgsland is stable enough that we do not need the vanguardist approach of Malenyevism. We are already in the process of such a transformation.”

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel: "“Valgslandian Socialism aims to eli..."
entries.dialogueText: “Valgslandian Socialism aims to eliminate the power of the state through the promotion of responsibility, freedom and well-being of the people. One of our key cornerstones is the devolution of big government to smaller councils with high citizen participation.”
